title: Java News Roundup: Java4Shell, Oracle CSPUs, OpenJDK, Azul Payara, BellSoft, Helidon, LangChain4j
gist: InfoQ's Java roundup for the week of November 16, 2026 is dominated by security: a new Java4Shell RCE (CVE-2026-114938) affecting Oracle Java SE and GraalVM, Oracle's November CSPU, 90 CVEs resolved across Spring projects, and two admin-bypass CVEs in Azul Payara. It also covers JDK 28 JEP progress (Lazy Constants targeted, Vector API 13th incubator) and point releases including LangChain4j agentic features.

insights.claim: A new remote code execution vulnerability called Java4Shell (CVE-2026-114938) affects Oracle Java SE versions 27.0.1.0.3, 25.0.5.0.3, 21.0.13.0.3, 17.0.21.0.3 and 8u511b33-perf, Oracle GraalVM for JDK 21 and 17, and GraalVM Enterprise Edition 21.3.20.0.3.
insights.speaker: Michael Redlich
insights.so_what: A Log4Shell-style naming suggests broad enterprise exposure, driving urgent patch cycles and security tooling demand across Java estates.

insights.claim: The Java4Shell CVE is described as difficult to exploit but allows an unauthenticated attacker with network access via multiple protocols to take over Oracle Java SE and GraalVM, exploitable by supplying data to APIs such as through a web service.
insights.speaker: Michael Redlich
insights.so_what: Server-side Java web services are exposed, raising remediation urgency for enterprises.
insights.quote: Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in takeover of Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for JDK, Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition.

insights.claim: The Oracle JDK versions listed as affected by Java4Shell include the same version numbers Oracle released in its November 2026 Critical Security Patch Update, such as 27.0.1.0.3 and 25.0.5.0.3.
insights.speaker: Michael Redlich
insights.so_what: Even freshly patched Oracle JDKs need further fixes, extending the remediation window.

insights.claim: BellSoft, Azul, JetBrains, GraalVM, Quarkus and WildFly have addressed the Java4Shell CVE, and BellSoft's Liberica JDK CSPU release includes a Java4Shell patch among 111 fixes and backports.
insights.speaker: Michael Redlich
insights.so_what: Rapid response by downstream OpenJDK distributors strengthens their competitive case against Oracle Java licensing.

insights.claim: The Spring team delivered GA releases across Spring Boot, Spring Framework, Spring Security, Spring AI and other projects in one week and resolved a total of 90 CVEs spanning multiple projects.
insights.speaker: Michael Redlich
insights.so_what: A large CVE batch in the dominant Java framework signals heavy enterprise patching workload.
insights.quote: The Spring team has also resolved a total of 90 CVEs spanning multiple projects.
insights.locator: It was a busy week over at Spring

insights.claim: Azul Payara 7.6.0 resolves five CVEs, including CVE-2026-90908 allowing unauthenticated JMX/RMI admin bypass via host spoofing that may lead to RCE, and CVE-2026-110003 allowing full server compromise via an arbitrary X-GlassFish-authToken header.
insights.speaker: Michael Redlich
insights.so_what: Critical admin-bypass flaws in application servers heighten security risk for Jakarta EE deployments.

insights.claim: JEP 547, Lazy Constants (Fourth Preview), is targeted for JDK 28 with no changes, offering immutable value holders initialized at most once with final-field performance and flexible initialization timing.
insights.speaker: Michael Redlich
insights.so_what: Incremental JVM performance features continue, supporting Java's position in startup-sensitive workloads.

insights.claim: JEP 548, the Vector API's thirteenth incubator, adds Vector<Float16> support for 16-bit floating-point lanes and will keep incubating until Project Valhalla features reach preview.
insights.speaker: Michael Redlich
insights.so_what: Float16 vector support aligns Java with AI/ML numerical workloads, though dependence on Valhalla delays production use.

themes.theme: Ecosystem releases including AI agent tooling

insights.claim: LangChain4j 1.24.0 adds DecisionSchedulerPlanner and DecisionModels classes for a decision model-based agentic pattern and supports resuming suspended agentic systems in AgentMonitor.
insights.speaker: Michael Redlich
insights.so_what: Agentic AI frameworks are maturing within the enterprise Java ecosystem.

insights.claim: Java Operator SDK 5.7.0 can enable virtual threads, adds a keepAlive() method, and is now built on Fabric8 Kubernetes Client 8.0.
insights.speaker: Michael Redlich
insights.so_what: Virtual threads adoption is spreading into Kubernetes operator tooling.
insights.locator: The release of Java Operator SDK 5.7.0

insights.claim: Helidon 27.0.2 raises the default in-memory decoded-input limit to 1 MiB and aligns with Oracle's November 2026 Critical Patch Updates across its 4.x and 3.x trains.
insights.speaker: Michael Redlich
insights.so_what: Oracle's own frameworks follow its quarterly patch cadence.

insights.claim: Micrometer Metrics 1.18.0 optimizes PrometheusMeterRegistry snapshot collection and Micrometer Tracing 1.8.0 simplifies baggage handling.
insights.speaker: Michael Redlich
insights.so_what: Observability libraries continue incremental performance improvements.
insights.locator: After two milestones and two releases

insights.claim: Hibernate Reactive 5.0.0.CR2 is the last release candidate for 5.0, which will be declared end-of-life at its GA release with focus shifting to 5.1.0, after a fix for a @TableGenerator deadlock.
insights.speaker: Michael Redlich
insights.so_what: Short support lifecycles push users to upgrade quickly.
